problems.description: Attackers send emails impersonating trusted entities to trick users into submitting their login credentials on fake websites.
risk_reduction: Implement multi-factor authentication (MFA) to reduce impact of stolen credentials
Deploy advanced email filtering and anti-phishing tools
Conduct regular user training and simulated phishing exercises

problems.description: Highly targeted phishing campaigns aimed at specific individuals or roles within an organization to gain sensitive information or access.
risk_reduction: Use threat intelligence to identify and block targeted phishing attempts
Educate high-risk users on recognizing spear phishing tactics
Enforce strict verification procedures for sensitive requests

problems.description: Attackers compromise or spoof executive email accounts to request fraudulent wire transfers or sensitive data from employees.
risk_reduction: Enable email authentication protocols like DMARC, DKIM, and SPF
Verify financial requests through secondary communication channels
Monitor email accounts for unusual activity and access patterns

problems.description: Misconfiguration of cloud storage services (e.g., S3 buckets) leading to unauthorized data exposure or leakage.
risk_reduction: Implement automated configuration scanning and compliance checks
Enforce least privilege access policies and encryption
Use cloud provider security posture management (CSPM) tools

problems.description: Attackers compromise software or hardware suppliers to insert malicious code or backdoors, impacting downstream organizations.
risk_reduction: Conduct rigorous third-party risk assessments and continuous monitoring
Implement software bill of materials (SBOM) and code integrity verification
Establish incident response plans inclusive of supply chain incidents

problems.description: Use of AI to generate highly convincing phishing content, including deepfake audio/video and personalized messages at scale.
risk_reduction: Deploy AI-powered detection tools to identify synthetic content
Enhance user awareness training focusing on AI-driven deception
Implement multi-factor authentication and out-of-band verification

problems.description: Attackers manipulate training data or model parameters to degrade or subvert machine learning model performance.
risk_reduction: Validate and sanitize training datasets
Use robust ML models with adversarial training
Monitor model behavior for anomalies and retrain regularly

problems.description: Ransomware operations offered as a service, lowering barriers for attackers and increasing ransomware prevalence.
risk_reduction: Implement endpoint detection and response (EDR) solutions
Maintain regular backups with offline copies
Apply timely patching and restrict administrative privileges
